subject: maths
question: Robert takes twice as much time as Tom and thrice as much time as George to complete a work. If working together, they can complete it in 23 hours, then find the time that Tom will take to complete the work.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. Let efficiency of **Robert** = 1, then efficiency of **Tom** = 2 and efficiency of **George** = 3. Total efficiency = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 units/hr. Total work = Combined efficiency × Total time = 6 × 23 = 138 units. Time taken by **Tom** = 138 ÷ 2 = 69 hr. **∴ The correct answer is 69 hr.**
